reviews.review:
Time for a pretty realistic review of this game, just want to mention  I have thousands of hours on many survival games.

1. Graphically very very good. Not that graphics should dictate how well a game plays, but in this case it really helps with the immersion.

2. Very Immersive, the background audio, the animal noises, gunfire ect. Very easy to get pulled in!

3. Gameplay, a few issues here nothing major especially for the cost. Hunting, fishing, foraging all seem to be  your average survival. However a few items should have their spawn increased. (Logs/Rocks). Food and Water.. Food drain is fine, however water goes down VERY fast. Not the worst because there is water all over to fill your bottles and it only takes a few seconds to cook on a camp fire, just kinda annoying.

4. Map: there isn't one, I have spent a bit of time getting lost, which was kinda cool. I would like to recommend being able to craft land markers that you can place.

5. Quest: here is the one bug?(working as intended?) I started a game in standard mode, then switched to  the casual mode, when I went back to story mode I lost all progress and was unable to continue my quest. I also started a game on Casual then went to Story and wasn't able to start, the tooltip makes it sound like you can bounce between if you wanted. however that doesn't seem to be the case.  This is my biggest complaint honestly. Either change the tooltip at the continue area or see what the bug is and fix.


Overall I would give this game a 4/5. I am enjoying the experience, and for the cost of the game I am pleased.  Room for improvement,  adjustment to water use, slight tweak on some ground items. Would love a basic building system but guessing this  is not part of the game design which I understand based on the game description.
